description: Source file implementing COSA (Cisco Open Service Architecture) API functions for OvsAgent, including initialization, shutdown, component discovery, parameter retrieval, and cleanup.

methods.name: Cosa_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COSA message bus handle and sets up subsystem info.

methods.name: Cosa_Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the COSA message bus handle.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Discovers the destination CCSP component supporting a given namespace.

methods.name: Cosa_GetParamValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values from a specified component and path.

methods.name: Cosa_FreeParamValues
methods.description: Frees the allocated parameter value structures.
